abilities.name: Acacia
abilities.desc: Slash through Enemies with your thorn covered sword Acacia.

abilities.name: Imperial Lash
abilities.desc: Unfurl your Sword in a long line, dealing True Damage to all Enemies it passes through. Hitting an Enemy Hero or Monster Roots them and causes you to dash to the furthest target hit.

abilities.name: Royal Flourish
abilities.desc:
Spin twice slashing your sword, dealing damage, gaining Movement Speed and Mesmerizing nearby Enemies. 
Then slam the ground, dealing True Damage.

abilities.name: Iron Rose
abilities.desc: Summon your shield and a barrier, increasing your hitbox and gaining Damage Reduction. Simultaneously attach Vines to nearby Enemies, dealing True Damage over time.

abilities.name: Queen’s Garden
abilities.desc: Leap up and slam shield down, summoning a massive Thornbush, Rooting, interrupting, and pulling down Enemies caught in the centre. The Thornbush Slows Enemies and deals True Damage whenever they move inside it.

abilities.name: Crown of Thorns
abilities.desc: Damaging Enemy Heroes applies Thorns. Allies damaging afflicted Enemies deal a portion of their damage as bonus True Damage.

abilities.name: Flay
abilities.desc: Flay your enemies with sharpened claws.

abilities.name: Crushing Maw
abilities.desc: Crush enemies in your gaping maw, damaging them while sustaining yourself.

abilities.name: Hellfire
abilities.desc: Launch the Demon's Eye at foes, revealing them as it spews damaging and slowing flames.

abilities.name: Web Lash
abilities.desc: Fire a web, rooting and slowing enemies caught in it, or latching yourself to terrain.

abilities.name: Consume
abilities.desc: Open your maw wide, pulling in all enemies in your path to consume those that get too close.

abilities.name: Pact of the Devourer
abilities.desc: Gain Hunger through battle and become Awakened to your true demonic power.

abilities.name: Arcrune Conduit
abilities.desc: Cast soul bolts with the Arcrune Conduit.

abilities.name: Particle Shredder
abilities.desc: Fire homing projectiles that deal damage from the Arcrune Conduit.

abilities.name: Dread Nova
abilities.desc: Lob an unstable orb of soul energy that deals damage and stuns.

abilities.name: Ether Crystal
abilities.desc: Summon an Ether Crystal at a target location. The Crystal will push enemies and launch allies. It deals damage and slows.

abilities.name: Synaptic Obliterator
abilities.desc: Charge up the arcrune engine to fire powerful energy beams that deal damage and slow

abilities.name: Disintegrate
abilities.desc: Your abilities apply a stack of Disintegration causing subsequent abilities to deal extra damage.

abilities.name: Shatter
abilities.desc: Slice through your enemies with your sword, Shatter.

abilities.name: Boreal Sweep
abilities.desc: Summon a wave of frost dealing damage and slowing. The frost then explodes, dealing damage again.

abilities.name: Glacial Charge
abilities.desc: Dash forward and leave behind a trail of ice that increases allied movement speed.

abilities.name: Hoarfrost
abilities.desc: Create a ring of frost that deals damage and roots enemies.

abilities.name: Cryoseism
abilities.desc: Freezes an area slowing enemies. After the slow enemies explode dealing damage and chaining the effect to those hit.

abilities.name: Frozen Simulacrum
abilities.desc:
Jump whilst airborne to leap in the direction of motion, leaving behind a Statue.

Damaging enemies summons a Frost Storm that deals damage.

abilities.name: Vigil
abilities.desc: Carve through Enemies with your massive sword.

abilities.name: Skull Crusher
abilities.desc: Smash your Enemies with a brutal slam, shattering their Armor.

abilities.name: Cursed Edge
abilities.desc: Pierce Enemies with slashes of cursed energy.

abilities.name: Dire Howl
abilities.desc: Howl a battle cry, intimidating your Enemies and growing stronger.

abilities.name: Kingslayer
abilities.desc: Dash forward, launching the first enemy Hero hit into the air before you relentlessly slice them to pieces.

abilities.name: Berserk
abilities.desc: Go berserk after tanking numerous blows, gaining a surge of power to fight back.

abilities.name: Maul
abilities.desc: Maul your foes with your mechanized Claws.

abilities.name: Chrono Swipe
abilities.desc: Lunge forward and swipe all Enemies in your path twice.

abilities.name: Detection Protocol
abilities.desc: Sniff the air, marking an enemy hero and generating a movement enhancing Scent Trail to them. Damaging the marked target slows them and grants you a Canister.

abilities.name: Primeval Roar
abilities.desc: Generate a defensive barrier, granting you damage reduction. After the duration or upon reactivation, it explodes, damaging and causing all nearby enemies to run away in fear.

abilities.name: Ursine Burst
abilities.desc: Dash forward, grabbing the first enemy hero you collide with. Then leap into the air and slam them into the ground, damaging and slowing all enemies in the landing zone.

abilities.name: Tesseract Device
abilities.desc: Every second basic attack on-hit generates a Canister. Canisters give bonus attack speed and healing on-hit. At max Canisters, unleash your Tesseract Core, gaining additional on-hit damage and healing.

abilities.name: Sophia & Marie
abilities.desc: Cut through foes with your twin Chokutos Sophia and Marie.

abilities.name: Blade Siphon
abilities.desc: Spin and strike everything around you dealing damage and healing yourself for everything hit.

abilities.name: Shadow Slip
abilities.desc: Rapidly dash to a location in a cloud of blood, dealing damage and slowing target's hit. Leaves behind a Shadow at your original position. Re-triggering the ability will return you to the Shadow's location.

abilities.name: Eventide
abilities.desc: Send out a cloud of darkness dealing damage in its path.

abilities.name: Feast
abilities.desc: Leap to a nearby Enemy Hero, forcing them to face you, suppressing them and dealing damage. Heal for half of the damage dealt.

abilities.name: Blood Tithe
abilities.desc: Repeat ability hits on enemy heroes applies haemorrhage, dealing damage and granting Countess  movement speed.

abilities.name: Crunch
abilities.desc: Beat down your enemies with your turbocharged fists.

abilities.name: Forward Crunch
abilities.desc:
Dash forward, dealing damage. Colliding with an enemy hero stuns.
Empowered: Dash an extended distance, Pushing Enemy Heroes along.

abilities.name: Left Crunch
abilities.desc:
Crunch swings his fist, dealing damage to enemies in front of him.
Empowered: Crunch swings both fists, dealing true damage instead.

abilities.name: Right Crunch
abilities.desc:
Crunch jabs, dealing damage and slowing everything hit.
Empowered: Deals damage and knocks them up instead.

abilities.name: Re-Crunch
abilities.desc:
Passive: Every third basic attack or ability hit heals you.

Active: Repeat the last ability used.

abilities.name: Cross Crunch
abilities.desc: After casting an ability, amplifies your next basic attack to deal damage and reduce your cooldowns. Additionally, every third ability used will be Empowered.

abilities.name: The Ionizer
abilities.desc: Send an energy bolt from your staff.

abilities.name: Stasis Bomb
abilities.desc: Launch a bouncing ball of energy, dealing damage and stunning enemies.

abilities.name: Photon Disruptor
abilities.desc: Release a drone that emits a beam of energy dealing damage and slowing all enemies hit.

abilities.name: Containment Fence
abilities.desc: Deploy a circular energy fence that prevents enemies from passing through.

abilities.name: Ion Strike
abilities.desc: Summon a bot above the target location that blasts the ground dealing damage and slowing enemies. Enemies directly under the beam will be stunned.

abilities.name: Rocket Boots
abilities.desc: Jump while airborne to activate Rocket Boots, propelling you upward and granting movement speed to nearby allies.

abilities.name: Lucy
abilities.desc: Tear through your enemies with your .45, Lucy.

abilities.name: Old Rusty
abilities.desc: Throw a boomerang, dealing damage and slowing enemies. Repeat the effect when returning.

abilities.name: Gag Grenade
abilities.desc: Toss a tear gas grenade that explodes dealing damage over time and silencing enemies.

abilities.name: Rad Rounds
abilities.desc: Load Lucy with radioactive rounds that cause a buildup in enemies, erupting to deal damage after a short duration. Damaging irradiated targets with Old Rusty or Shrapnel Cannon causes them to erupt immediately.

abilities.name: Shrapnel Cannon
abilities.desc: Unleash a blast of shrapnel, dealing damage and reducing enemy physical armor. This attack when used In-Air sends you flying backwards.

abilities.name: Wastelander
abilities.desc: Critical strikes and ability hits apply a bleed to enemies.

abilities.name: Nova Repeater/Plasma Claws
abilities.desc: Fire a fully automatic barrage with your ranged basic attack or unleash a rapid four-hit light attack chain, culminating in a powerful heavy-hitting finisher.

abilities.name: Sidewind/Talon Drive
abilities.desc:
Ranged: Thrust upwards and empower your next basic attack to fire an explosive Railshot.

Melee: Dash to a Target enemy and unleash a powerful uppercut.

abilities.name: Tachyon Lance/Axiom Strike
abilities.desc:
Ranged: Fire a laser that pierces through all enemies in its path.

Melee: Spin 4 times with your claws, then unleash a slowing lightning strike forward.

abilities.name: Zero Shift
abilities.desc:
Switch between Ranged and Melee stances, changing your abilities.
Gaining bonus Physical Power in Ranged stance and Healing when damaging enemy Heroes in Melee stance.

abilities.name: Limit Break
abilities.desc:
Ranged: Fly upwards and bombard a Target area with four energy beams.

Melee: Teleport to a location and unleash a mobile flurry of strikes, culminating in a devastating finisher from above.

abilities.name: Helios Core
abilities.desc: Damage enemy Heroes to build Heat. Upon reaching max Heat, you may activate a Limit Break ability.

abilities.name: Windwalker
abilities.desc: Slice through enemies with your glaive, Windwalker.

abilities.name: Reaping Dash
abilities.desc: Teleport forward, dealing damage to everything in your path.

abilities.name: Safeguard
abilities.desc: Envelop yourself with a Spellshield that blocks the next ability hit and grants you additional power and movement speed.

abilities.name: Hamstring
abilities.desc: Spin twice, dealing damage and slowing all enemies around you. Isolated targets take more damage.

abilities.name: Earth Shatter
abilities.desc: Slam the ground, causing massive spikes to rise up. This deals damage and executes any enemy below the threshold.

abilities.name: Executioners Path
abilities.desc: Unique Hero Takedowns permanently grant physical penetration.

abilities.name: The Inverter
abilities.desc: Fire deadly bolts of electricity at your enemies with The Inverter.

abilities.name: Energy Shield
abilities.desc: Activate a shield that blocks the next enemy ability.

abilities.name: Displacement Blast
abilities.desc:
Fire an empowered shot forward that deals damage.
In Assault Mode, the shot displaces enemies.

abilities.name: Assault Mode
abilities.desc:
Swap between Assault and Sentry Mode.
Sentry: Basic Attacks restore mana.
Assault: Basic Attacks cost mana, but have increased range and deal extra damage.

abilities.name: GTFO
abilities.desc: Lock onto an enemy hero and launch an orb that passes through all terrain dealing massive damage.

abilities.name: Pulsefire
abilities.desc: Your basic attacks and abilities apply Pulsefire to Enemies. The next basic attack or ability will burst the Pulsefire dealing damage.

abilities.name: Spark
abilities.desc: Electrify enemies with shock bolts from your generator.

abilities.name: Seek and Destroy
abilities.desc: Release an airborne droid. Upon stopping, the droid slows and deals damage over time to enemies beneath it.

abilities.name: Sticky Mine
abilities.desc: Launch a sticky mine that attaches to any nearby unit. After a delay the mine explodes, dealing damage.

abilities.name: Security Gate
abilities.desc: Throw forward an electrical gate, granting allies that pass through it decaying movement speed. If an enemy passes through, the gate deals damage and roots them.

abilities.name: Tesla Dome
abilities.desc: Unleash your Tesla Dome, dealing damage and expanding over time. This damage reduces armour and slows for a duration.

abilities.name: Field Data Accumulation
abilities.desc: Damaging Heroes and Killing Targets grants Data that permanently increases your Magical Power.

abilities.name: Portal Blast
abilities.desc: Fire rift bolts at your enemies.

abilities.name: Void Breach
abilities.desc: Launch forward a comet, dealing damage and slowing enemies in its path.

abilities.name: Cosmic Rift
abilities.desc: Rip down a meteor from the sky, dealing damage to enemies caught in the area of impact.

abilities.name: Torn Space
abilities.desc: Leap through a portal in spacetime, appearing at the target location.

abilities.name: Black Hole
abilities.desc: Unleash a black hole underneath you that pulls enemies towards the centre, constantly dealing damage.

abilities.name: Cosmic Power
abilities.desc: Damaging a hero with an ability empowers your next basic attack. This attack teathers you to your target, slowing and damaging them.

abilities.name: Lightbringer
abilities.desc: Cleave through enemies with your sword, Lightbringer.

abilities.name: Assault The Gates
abilities.desc: Leap forward, dealing damage upon landing.

abilities.name: Make Way
abilities.desc: Surround yourself in a fiery whirlwind that deals damage.

abilities.name: Sacred Oath
abilities.desc: Bathe your sword in holy fire to enhance your next basic attack to deal extra damage and slow enemies.

abilities.name: Stone Forged Soul
abilities.desc: Enter Stasis and restore health while slowing enemies. Then, crash down, dealing massive damage to enemies.

abilities.name: Stoicism
abilities.desc: Periodically deflect incoming basic attacks. Regenerate health and gain armor as you lose health.

abilities.name: The Chieftains Warclubs
abilities.desc: Use the Chieftains Warclubs to pulverise your enemies.

abilities.name: Double Pain
abilities.desc: Using the Chieftains Clubs cleave all enemies dealing damage.

abilities.name: Smash 'n Grab
abilities.desc: Smash the ground, sending forth a shockwave that pulls all enemies towards you, dealing damage and stunning.

abilities.name: Stampede
abilities.desc: After a short delay, dash forward a long distance. Enemies passed through are damaged, slowed, and dragging Enemy Heroes along with Grux.

abilities.name: Warlord's Challenge
abilities.desc: Slam your clubs together stunning all nearby enemies. Gain attack speed and steal power from those you hit for a duration.

abilities.name: Bloodlust
abilities.desc: Your basic attacks bleed enemies, dealing damage over time.

abilities.name: Cannon
abilities.desc: Fire explosive shells at your enemies that deal splash damage.

abilities.name: H11 Cluster Grenades
abilities.desc: Launch a cluster of proximity mines that explode when an enemy touches them, dealing damage and slowing.

abilities.name: R2000 Missile
abilities.desc: Fire a long range rocket that explodes on impact, dealing damage. The rocket can be charged up over a short duration to deal more damage.

abilities.name: Land Mine
abilities.desc: Lob a mine that can be retriggered to explode dealing damage and knocking back enemies.

abilities.name: Make It Rain
abilities.desc: Thrust up into the sky and rain down a barrage of rockets in the direction you're looking dealing massive damage.

abilities.name: Armed Salvo
abilities.desc: Periodically your basic attack deals bonus AoE damage around the Target.

abilities.name: Spew
abilities.desc: Coat your enemies in oil with Scorchs flammable spit.

abilities.name: Molotov
abilities.desc: Iggy flings a Molotov that deals damage to enemies hit by the explosion. A Fire Field will remain where the explosion occurs, dealing damage over time.

abilities.name: Flame Turret
abilities.desc: Iggy throws down a turret that shoots damaging fireballs at enemies. Hitting an enemy with Spew redirects turrets to attack that target.

abilities.name: Oil Spill
abilities.desc: Scorch hurls a ball of oil that deals damage and slows enemies.

abilities.name: Inferno
abilities.desc: Scorch unleashes a cone of flame gaining movement speed and dealing damage. At the end of the duration Scorch will deal damage and knock back enemy targets within the cone.

abilities.name: Badlands Critter
abilities.desc: Basic attacks coat enemies in oil and slow them. Oiled enemies will become ignited by Iggy's fire attacks causing enemies to burn for extra damage.

abilities.name: Fathom
abilities.desc: Use your enchanted Trident to shoot streams of water with a high impact.

abilities.name: Brine
abilities.desc: Fire a rapid Hydroblast that deals damage and pops Bubbles. Killing Enemies with Hydroblast or Bubble pops with Brine generates Gold.

abilities.name: Narcosis
abilities.desc: Release a unit piercing Water Sphere that floats towards Enemies dealing Damage and stopping on the first Enemy Hero hit, Suspending them.

abilities.name: Hydroclasm
abilities.desc: Create an Abyssal Bubble at a targeted location. If the Bubble is hit by Brine or your Basic Attack, it pops, dealing damage and refunding mana. The Bubble will amplify after a short duration, dealing increased damage and slowing.

abilities.name: Genesis
abilities.desc: Rise high into the sky and unleash a disruptive Waterspout that pierces walls. When the Waterspout hits an Enemy, they will be knocked up and slowed upon landing.

abilities.name: Herald
abilities.desc: Gain bonus effects based on your selected Eternal, empowering your abilities further.

abilities.name: Plasteel Swords
abilities.desc: Unleash razor sharp attacks with your ultralight Plasteel Swords.

abilities.name: Crippling Dagger
abilities.desc: Throw a dagger, dealing damage slowing enemies. Max Charges: 2.

abilities.name: Shadow Walk
abilities.desc: Gain Health Regeneration out of vision. Activate to enter Camouflage and gain movement speed.

abilities.name: Shadow Dance
abilities.desc: Backflip into the sky, allowing you to dash at a target enemy and deal damage, increasing if they're affected by Death Mark.

abilities.name: Guillotine
abilities.desc: Dash forward, cutting through all Enemies in your path, dealing massive damage.

abilities.name: Death Mark
abilities.desc: Damaging enemies reveals them and deals damage after a delay. Additionally, Kallari can jump multiple times.

abilities.name: Rage & Spirit
abilities.desc: Brutalize your foes with your primal twin axes, Rage and Spirit.

abilities.name: Ambush
abilities.desc: Leap to an enemy dealing damage and slowing them.

abilities.name: Unleash
abilities.desc: Gain an incredible amount of attack speed for a short duration allowing you to tear through enemies.

abilities.name: Invigorate
abilities.desc: Cleanse all debuffs and receive a burst of healing.

abilities.name: Cull
abilities.desc: Unleash a primal roar, slashing all enemies in front of you for heavy damage and stunning them.

abilities.name: Ancestral Fury
abilities.desc: Dealing damage builds Rage, increasing your Health Regeneration and Cooldown Progression. Maintaining high Rage grants Movement Speed. Go too long without attacking and your Rage decays.

abilities.name: Wrath
abilities.desc: Fire lethal bolts at your prey with your hand crossbow, Wrath.

abilities.name: Mercy
abilities.desc: Equip Mercy to fire a powerful shot, dealing damage and applying Vengeance stacks. Mercy can critically strike, benefits from lifesteal, and applies on-hit effects.

abilities.name: Dusk
abilities.desc:
Passive: Mark enemies with Vengeance, increasing your damage against them.
Active: Purify any enemies that are marked with Vengeance, dealing damage based on stacks and slowing for a duration.

abilities.name: Shadow Glide
abilities.desc: Dash in your current movement direction, and gain power for a duration.

abilities.name: Purge
abilities.desc: Unleash a torrent of arrows and bullets in an area. Enemies take damage over the duration. You can cast Shadow Glide during this window.

abilities.name: Nevermore
abilities.desc: Periodically become empowered, causing your next Basic Attack or Mercy to fire a Raven. The Raven explodes on impact, dealing Current Health damage to nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Heavenly Blade
abilities.desc: Electrify your foes with the Heavenly Blade.

abilities.name: Light of the Heavens
abilities.desc:
Light strikes the Heavenly Blade, dealing damage in an AoE.
If you are holding the blade, gain a shield.
If the blade is in the world, deal extra damage.

abilities.name: Judgement of the Heavens
abilities.desc: Throw the Heavenly Blade to a location to deal damage. Enemies become tethered to the blade.

abilities.name: Surge of the Heavens
abilities.desc:
Dash forward dealing damage to all enemies passed through.
If the blade is in your path, knock up and deal extra damage to enemies.

abilities.name: Fury of the Heavens
abilities.desc: Teleport to the Heavenly Blade creating a massive electrical explosion dealing massive damage to all enemies.

abilities.name: Strike of the Heavens
abilities.desc: Dealing ability damage will energise the Heavenly Blade. Whilst Energised, you gain attack speed and your basic attacks deal extra damage in an AoE around the target.

abilities.name: K-75 Storm Rifle
abilities.desc: Gun down enemy hostiles with your highly precise K-75 Storm Rifle.

abilities.name: Frag Order
abilities.desc: Cook and lob a Grenade dealing damage to enemies and launching you upwards. If held for full duration the Grenade explodes in your hand.

abilities.name: Saturation Charge
abilities.desc: Launch an Energy Rocket that clusters into Mines on impact that deal damage and slow.

abilities.name: Rally Point
abilities.desc: Place a Standard and gain unstoppable for a short duration and knocking back enemies hit. Allies near the Standard gain movement speed and heal, whilst you gain infinite ammo.

abilities.name: Orbital Sanction
abilities.desc: Throw a Designator, after a short delay a Beam will blast the targeted location, following enemies.

abilities.name: Ballistic Calibration
abilities.desc: Convert Attack Speed into Ability Haste and enhance your abilities based on purchased stats.

abilities.name: OA-S3000 SMG
abilities.desc: Send bullets down range with your OA-S3000 SMG.

abilities.name: Void Bomb
abilities.desc:
Place a bomb that detonates after a short delay, dealing damage.

Innovation: Detonate again after a short time.

abilities.name: Seismic Assault
abilities.desc:
Slam the ground, sending forth a seismic wave that deals damage and knocks up enemies after a short duration.

Innovation: Increased stun duration.

abilities.name: Void Drone
abilities.desc:
Deploy a drone that drains enemy mana and attacks them when damaging them with an ability or if they cast an ability, dealing damage and draining their mana.

Innovation: The drone's attacks drain additional mana.

abilities.name: Neural Disruptor
abilities.desc:
Fire a piercing blast from your sidearm, dealing damage to targets, increased based on their missing mana, and silencing them. Deals missing health damage to Manaless Heroes instead.

Innovation: Resets Cooldown if an Enemy Hero is killed.

abilities.name: Innovation
abilities.desc: Your abilities gain additional strength at maximum rank. Gains increased ability haste each time you max out an ability.

abilities.name: Ta-da!
abilities.desc: Fling small gemstones at Enemies.

abilities.name: Maco Sparkle!
abilities.desc: Throw a slow, explosive gemstone to damage and Stun Enemies. Can be reactivated early.

abilities.name: Maco Gift!
abilities.desc: Lob a gemstone that damages Enemies and Heals Allies, additionally granting them Movement Speed.

abilities.name: Maco Fly!
abilities.desc: Leap high into the air and crush enemies with your giant gem, damaging and Slowing Enemies. Gain a Shield for hitting Enemy Heroes.

abilities.name: Maco Strike!
abilities.desc: Charge up and send a giant gemstone flying, damaging and Pushing Enemy Heroes. The gemstone then explodes, damaging and Stunning in an area.

abilities.name: Mach Speed!
abilities.desc: Gain Movement Speed while moving, gaining Slow Immunity at max stacks. Stacks removed on being hit by an Enemy Hero.

abilities.name: Fetid Dagger
abilities.desc: Throw Fetid Daggers at your enemies.

abilities.name: Mark
abilities.desc: Deal damage to a target, restoring health. If they are a Hero, their soul is rended into your doll, Marking them.

abilities.name: Hive
abilities.desc: Throw a hive of insects that explodes dealing damage and Slowing targets hit.

abilities.name: Swarm
abilities.desc: Become the swarm, gaining movement speed and damage reduction for a duration. Passing through enemies deals damage and restores health.

abilities.name: Curse
abilities.desc: Summon a horde of insects to stab the marked target, dealing massive damage.

abilities.name: Pestilence
abilities.desc: Your abilities apply Pestilence for a duration, dealing damage over time.

abilities.name: Clobber
abilities.desc: Bludgeon enemies with your wooden fist.

abilities.name: Abduct
abilities.desc: Wind up powerful vines that launch forward, damaging and pulling the first unfortunate enemy target hit towards you.

abilities.name: Contagion
abilities.desc: Vomit bugs that heal and protect Allied Heroes whilst damaging and shredding Enemies.

abilities.name: Beguile
abilities.desc: Channel energy, slowing yourself but gaining damage reduction. After the duration or upon reactivation, damage and mesmerize nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Eclipse
abilities.desc: Channel and absorb all light from the galaxy, preventing Enemy Heroes from seeing beyond a small radius. You also apply Contagion to all Heroes and grant yourself movement speed for the duration.

abilities.name: Extract
abilities.desc: Swipe with a magical vine that damages enemies, absorbing their essence, healing Mourn.

abilities.name: The Enforcer
abilities.desc: Bombard your enemies with bullets from your hip fired rifle, The Enforcer.

abilities.name: Buckshot
abilities.desc: Discharge a shotgun blast, dealing more damage the closer the enemy is and reducing their armour. The blast pushes enemies back.

abilities.name: Static Trap
abilities.desc: Place an energy trap that deals damage and roots enemy heroes.

abilities.name: Hot Pursuit
abilities.desc: Activate your sirens, gaining movement speed and attack speed.

abilities.name: Long Arm of the Law
abilities.desc: Kneel and prepare an energised sniper shot with unlimited range that can travel through anything. This shot deals massive damage.

abilities.name: Shots Fired
abilities.desc: Periodically, your next basic attack has increased range and deals more damage.

abilities.name: Orb
abilities.desc: Turn your shielding energy offensive with this ranged basic attack.

abilities.name: Serenity
abilities.desc: Charge up a piercing bolt of energy that damages and slows enemies. Deals increased damage and stuns at full charge.

abilities.name: Consecrated Ground
abilities.desc: Bless a large area, granting attack speed and health regeneration to Allies within. Enemies standing in the zone take damage over time and suffer reduced attack speed.

abilities.name: Alacrity
abilities.desc: Throw an orb that shields and grants movement speed to yourself or Allied Heroes.

abilities.name: Reversal Of Fortune
abilities.desc: Grant an Allied Hero damage reduction and a large shield for a short duration before soaring to their location. On arrival, damage and knock up nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Sentinel
abilities.desc: Muriel’s abilities apply anti-heal to enemies and grant a buff to Allies that increases the healing and shielding they receive.

abilities.name: Drumclubs
abilities.desc: Beat your opponents like a drum with your Drumclubs.

abilities.name: Thunk
abilities.desc: Toss a Drumclub that damages and stuns enemies in a tiny area around the target.

abilities.name: March!
abilities.desc: Bellow out a rallying war cry, bolstering Song Of My People for a duration.

abilities.name: Song Of My People
abilities.desc: Toggle: Play a soothing beat to either heal, or grant increased movement speed, to yourself and nearby Allies.

abilities.name: Crash Bang Boom!
abilities.desc: Channel a drum solo over a short duration that slows nearby enemies, before mesmerizing them. The final beat of the solo deals increased damage, knocking up and stunning targets hit.

abilities.name: Mosh Pit
abilities.desc: Gain increased physical power and armors for each nearby Hero.

abilities.name: Jolt
abilities.desc: Fire Energy bolts at your enemies.

abilities.name: Erase Vector
abilities.desc: Dissolve into a data stream and dash, leaving fading holographic copies in your path. Your next Jolt explodes, damaging and slowing enemies.

abilities.name: L.I.N.X
abilities.desc: Release a Data Construct that shears through enemies in its path. It returns to your location, dealing True Damage on the recall.

abilities.name: Data Burst
abilities.desc: Launch a volatile data cluster that detonates on impact, damaging and slowing enemies caught in the blast radius.

abilities.name: Final Thread
abilities.desc: Push your systems beyond their limits, entering a state of hyper-mobility where every ability is permanently Overclocked. You may end the protocol early to launch an explosive finisher.

abilities.name: Neural Network
abilities.desc: Weave your spells to generate Threads. Once complete, your system Overclocks, empowering your next basic ability.

abilities.name: Pulse Bolt
abilities.desc: Fire psychic bolts at your enemies.

abilities.name: Telekinetic Link
abilities.desc: Create a link between yourself and an ally, granting both increased power. If reactivated, pull the linked ally towards you.

abilities.name: Psychic Flare
abilities.desc: Blast a flare of psychic energy around you and your linked ally, dealing damage, and reducing your Blink cooldown when hitting Heroes. Enemies facing the flair become blinded.

abilities.name: Energy Lance
abilities.desc: Channel a beam of energy dealing damage over time. Each instance progressively slows until they become rooted.

abilities.name: Hyperflux
abilities.desc: Phase overcharges herself and her linked ally, granting both increased attack speed, ability haste, and movement speed for a duration.

abilities.name: Essence Catalyst
abilities.desc: After casting an ability, restore health over time. Linked allies receive the same healing. Additionally enhances your Blink.

abilities.name: Swipe
abilities.desc: Pulverise your enemies with your primal fists.

abilities.name: Pounce
abilities.desc:
Leap forward before slamming down to the ground, dealing damage.

While in Behemoth: Increase the leap range.

abilities.name: Boulder Throw
abilities.desc:
Rip a boulder from the ground. Throw the boulder, dealing damage and stunning all enemies in its path,

While in Behemoth: Throw the boulder instantly.

abilities.name: Rumble
abilities.desc:
Pound the ground with each fist, dealing damage and slowing enemies.

While in Behemoth: Cooldown is significantly reduced.

abilities.name: Behemoth
abilities.desc: Become enraged, growing in size, gaining health, and empowering your abilities for a duration.

abilities.name: King of the Jungle
abilities.desc: Gain health regeneration that is increased while in the Jungle. Being immobilised restores health and grants tenacity.

abilities.name: Vow
abilities.desc: Fire bolts of chaotic energy at your foes.

abilities.name: Soulfire
abilities.desc: Spin your cane, unleashing multiple waves of chaotic energy that pierce through and damage all enemies in their path.

abilities.name: Mortal Coil
abilities.desc: Launch a Soul Orb that pulls in and damages foes. Heal yourself when damaging enemies that are caught in its area.

abilities.name: Stupor
abilities.desc: Leap into the air and fire an Orb of Deception, mesmerizing and damaging any enemies caught in its explosion.

abilities.name: Abyssal Rift
abilities.desc: Teleport to a location and summon an infernal singularity above you that repeatedly attacks all nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Echoes of the Damned
abilities.desc: Renna can hover by jumping while airborne. Enemies also drop Essence when they die. Collect it to improve your abilities.

abilities.name: Fate
abilities.desc: Eviscerate your enemies with your .90 hand cannon, Fate. Holds 4 rounds, the final round will always critically strike.

abilities.name: Hellfire Rounds
abilities.desc:
Passive: Increases critical strike damage and boost Fourth Shot damage.

Active: Reload your hand cannon.

abilities.name: Obliterate
abilities.desc: Unleash ethereal missiles within a wide cone that home to a marked target or random enemies if none are marked.

abilities.name: Scar
abilities.desc: Scar the target enemy dealing damage and marking them for a duration. Marked enemies take additional damage and consumes stacks. Consuming all stacks roots the target.

abilities.name: Reckoning
abilities.desc: Revenant pulls himself and his target into the Nether Realm for a duration, stealing a portion of their powers. Gain increased gold from kills while inside the Nether Realm.

abilities.name: Bounty Hunter
abilities.desc: Increase your power based on critical strike chance and attacks speed. Killing an enemy hero grants additional gold.

abilities.name: Whip
abilities.desc: Shred your enemies with devastating lashes from your chains.

abilities.name: Riplash
abilities.desc: Launch your chain forward, attaching to the first Enemy hit, dealing damage and pulling them towards you.

abilities.name: Shock Therapy
abilities.desc: Swing an electrified whip, removing shields, dealing damage and silencing enemies.

abilities.name: Electrocute
abilities.desc: Emit an electrical aura, granting you a Shield and Movement Speed. The aura deals damage over time to enemies around you.

abilities.name: Skewer
abilities.desc: Unleash a torrent of chains, dealing damage and suppressing enemies hit. Repeat the damage at the end of the suppression.

abilities.name: Suspended Sentence
abilities.desc: Applying crowd control short circuits Enemy Heroes, halting their cooldown progression.

abilities.name: Cindara
abilities.desc: Slice through your Enemies with your fiery Blade.

abilities.name: Minueta
abilities.desc: Twirl fiercely, then unleash a series of damaging stabs, with the final stab dealing bonus damage based on the Enemy's Missing Health.

abilities.name: Ashen Vow
abilities.desc: Swing your lantern around you dealing Damage. If the Outer Edge hits Enemies it deals more Damage and slows them, and empowers your next Cindara attack if it hits a Hero or Camp Leader.

abilities.name: First Intent
abilities.desc: Rapidly dash forward, with a decisive fiery strike. Damages all Enemies hit. Restore Energy and gain a larger shield for each Hero or Camp Leader hit.

abilities.name: Swan Song
abilities.desc: Wrap your Lantern around an Enemy Hero, Restraining them and Slowing Enemies around them. After Restraining them, strike down dealing Damage to Enemies around you and set your Rapier Ablaze, empowering your abilities and gaining basic attack range.

abilities.name: Last Light
abilities.desc: Use Energy instead of Mana, convert Bonus Mana into Physical Power.

abilities.name: The Nephilim
abilities.desc: Beat your foes into submission with your mace, The Nephilim.

abilities.name: Chastise
abilities.desc: Clap your wings in front of you dealing damage and slowing. Cast speed increases with attack speed.

abilities.name: Heaven's Fury
abilities.desc: Mark a target and vanish, striking enemies at their location. Each strike deals damage. Then, teleport to the marked enemy's location.

abilities.name: Ascend
abilities.desc: Rise up into the air and hover while targetting an area. Then, dive down and deal damage.

abilities.name: Heresy
abilities.desc: Take on your demonic form, dealing damage to nearby enemies and setting them ablaze. Gain movement speed, attack speed, and damage over time on your basic attacks.

abilities.name: Fallen Grace
abilities.desc: Takedowns on heroes leave behind an orb. Upon touching it, activate Heresy and reduce your current basic ability cooldowns.

abilities.name: The Harbinger
abilities.desc: Beat your enemies into submission with The Harbinger

abilities.name: Phantom Rush
abilities.desc: Dash forward, gliding through any Enemies in your path, dealing damage and causing targets hit to run away in fear.

abilities.name: Siphon
abilities.desc: Strike forward with a spectral hand, dealing damage and temporarily stealing Maximum Health from Enemy Heroes

abilities.name: Subjugate
abilities.desc: Call down a miasma of dark energy, dealing damage and chaining enemies to the centre. Chained targets that move away from the centre break the chain, damaging and stunning them.

abilities.name: Colossal Blow
abilities.desc: Deliver a heavy blow from The Harbinger, dealing damage and sending all enemies flying.

abilities.name: Reaper of Souls
abilities.desc: Gains Souls when killing enemies with abilities. Each Soul grants bonus health, and Sevarog gains new effects after set amounts are gained.

abilities.name: Kiba
abilities.desc: Dice up your enemies with your sword.

abilities.name: Rushing Beat
abilities.desc: Dash forward, dealing damage to all enemies you pass through.

abilities.name: Line Tempo
abilities.desc: Summon a spirit wolf that runs in a straight line and passes through all enemies, dealing damage.

abilities.name: Circle Rhythm
abilities.desc: Summon spirit wolves that circle you, granting movement speed and a shield for a duration. The wolves deal damage to nearby enemies.

abilities.name: All-Kill!
abilities.desc:
Passive: Damaging Enemy Heroes with abilities marks them and grants stacks of Track for a duration. At maximum stacks, you may activate All-Kill.
Active: Summon a pack of spirit wolves above marked Heroes that strike them, dealing damage with each hit.

abilities.name: Biting Melody
abilities.desc: Basic attacks deal additional damage. Periodically this effect deals even more damage and restores mana.

abilities.name: Starfire
abilities.desc: Ignite the battlefield with Starfire's celestial fury.

abilities.name: Hypercharge
abilities.desc: Hypercharge Starfire to instead project a beam that deals massive single target damage.

abilities.name: Plasma Grenade
abilities.desc: Launch a sticky grenade that detonates, slowing and damaging enemies.

abilities.name: Air Assault
abilities.desc: Launch yourself upwards to fly and launch missiles at targets you damage.

abilities.name: Atomiser
abilities.desc: Charge and unleash a nuclear projectile that deals massive damage at long range.

abilities.name: Dissonance
abilities.desc: Jump higher and cause explosions on killing enemies.

abilities.name: Heartpiercer
abilities.desc: Fire precision arrows at your enemies with your bow, Heartpiercer.

abilities.name: Piercing Shot
abilities.desc: Charge a long range terrain piercing arrow that deals damage to all enemies in its path.

abilities.name: Hail of Arrows
abilities.desc: Release a storm of arrows that rain down, dealing damage and slowing all enemies in the area.

abilities.name: Heightened Senses
abilities.desc: Vanish from view, becoming Stealthed temporarily. Upon reappearing, become empowered, gaining attack speed and enhancing every second basic attack against the same target to deal increased damage.

abilities.name: Inner Fire
abilities.desc: Invoke your blazing spirit, augmenting Heartpiercer to release a fan of piercing arrows over a short duration.

abilities.name: Relentless
abilities.desc: Dealing damage applies stacks of Relentless to enemy targets. Deal additional damage to enemies with Relentless stacks.

abilities.name: Punch
abilities.desc: Beat your opponents to a pulp with your heavy hitting fists.

abilities.name: Shield Bash
abilities.desc: Swipe forward dealing damage and stunning all enemies in front of you.

abilities.name: Bull Rush
abilities.desc: Charge forward, dealing damage and sending enemies flying.

abilities.name: Force Shield
abilities.desc: Deploy a disruptive wall of energy, blocking all incoming Enemy Projectiles.

abilities.name: Shield Slam
abilities.desc: Leap into the sky and crash down at the target location to deal damage and knock up enemies.

abilities.name: Cybernetic Shell
abilities.desc: Shield yourself after remaining out of combat for a duration and gain increased defences.

abilities.name: Skullsplitter
abilities.desc: Cleave through your enemies with your battleaxe, Skullsplitter.

abilities.name: Wild Rush
abilities.desc:
Become Unstoppable before dashing forward, damaging and stunning the target hit.

Empowered: Gain a shield after hitting an enemy.

abilities.name: Ruthless Assault
abilities.desc:
Spin your axe, striking all Enemies around you twice.

Empowered: Strike three times instead.

abilities.name: Highland Hurl
abilities.desc:
Throw a spectral axe, dealing damage. Enemies hit are slowed and have their Physical Armor reduced.

Empowered: Roots enemies hit for a duration.

abilities.name: Unstoppable Force
abilities.desc: Slam your helmet down, cleansing all debuffs, disabling nearby Enemy Towers and gain max Hersir stacks instantly. Additionally, you becomes buffed for a short duration.

abilities.name: Hersir
abilities.desc:
Gain bonus Armors while under Towers, and generate stacks when damaging Enemies.

At maximum stacks, Terra's next Basic Ability is Empowered with additional effects.

abilities.name: Floret
abilities.desc: Fire ferocious flowers at your prey.

abilities.name: Untamed Growth
abilities.desc: Hurl a small plant that deals damage over time then explodes for even more damage.

abilities.name: Bramble Patch
abilities.desc: Summon a patch of thorny brambles, dealing damage and slowing enemies whilst speeding up allies.

abilities.name: Harvest Nettles
abilities.desc: Throw an orb of nature energy, dealing heavy damage.

abilities.name: Fly Trap
abilities.desc: Plant a magical seedling, awakening a giant fly trap that attaches itself to all nearby enemy heroes. After a brief delay, it Pulls its victims inward, dealing damage and stunning.

abilities.name: Nature's Vengeance
abilities.desc: Each time you kill an enemy, spawn an Untamed Growth on their corpse.

abilities.name: LUNARI 4.0
abilities.desc: Fire a cartrige of superheated plasma from each of the LUNARI 4.0s.

abilities.name: Vortex Grenade
abilities.desc: Launch a grenade that explodes upon contact with an enemy, dealing damage and slowing.

abilities.name: Vaporize
abilities.desc: Charge and fire two superheated piercing projectiles, each dealing damage.

abilities.name: Rocket Dash
abilities.desc: Roll or dash in the direction of movement depending on if you're in the air.

abilities.name: Ventilate
abilities.desc: Set the LUNARI 4.0s to full auto, unleashing a barrage of bullets over three seconds that deals a massive amount of damage.

abilities.name: Gunslinger
abilities.desc: Casting an ability will cause your next basic attack to fire three times.

abilities.name: Crimson Sigil
abilities.desc: Torture your enemies by firing powerful blood strikes.

abilities.name: Arterial Grip
abilities.desc: Bind an unfortunate Soul to you, dealing damage over time whilst slowing and grounding them. Steal attack speed from them whilst tethered.

abilities.name: Rupture
abilities.desc: Manifest replicas of your Blade. After a short delay, they sequentially launch forward, dealing damage in a small area.

abilities.name: Bloodbound
abilities.desc: Actively target Lilith dealing Damage to Enemies in an area whilst gaining Attack Speed. Whenever Bloodbound is leveled, the Damage of Hemophagias is increased.

abilities.name: Exsanguinate
abilities.desc: Unleash terrifying swarms of bats that deal magical damage when hitting enemies. The Bats then return and heal Valmont.

abilities.name: Hemophagia
abilities.desc: Lilith hunts her prey, striking Enemies damaged by you. Regenerate Mana by consuming souls of Enemies taken down. Restoration is increased on Hero Deaths.

abilities.name: The Neutralizer
abilities.desc: Snipe your enemies with pinpoint precision with The Neutralizer.

abilities.name: Knock, Knock!
abilities.desc: Fire a sniper shot that deals high damage. If this ability hits a marked target, deal extra damage and reduce the cooldown.

abilities.name: Peekaboo!
abilities.desc: Launch a piercing Nanite Grenade that deals damage, slows, and marks everything hit.

abilities.name: Surprise, Surprise!
abilities.desc: Enter Camouflage and gain movement speed. Takedowns will reset the cooldown of Surprise.

abilities.name: Back It Up!
abilities.desc: Choose a nearby enemy hero and mark their location from 2s prior. After a delay they will teleport back to this location.

abilities.name: Who's There?
abilities.desc: Your Vision Item becomes a Sonar Drone that when launched will scan the surrounding area,

abilities.name: Ruyi Jingu Bang
abilities.desc: Beat your opponents senseless with the iconic Gold-Banded Staff.

abilities.name: Windsurge/Force Push
abilities.desc:
Spirit: Dash forward with the wind, dealing damage.
Body: Force your enemies and clones away and deal damage.

abilities.name: Cloudwalker/Pole Vault
abilities.desc:
Spirit: Create walkable clouds beneath you.
Body: Leap in a direction and gain Attack Speed.

abilities.name: Cyclebreaker/High Impact
abilities.desc:
Spirit: Gain Damage Reduction and Stun Enemies.
Body: Slam down dealing more damage based on height.

abilities.name: 84000 Hairs
abilities.desc: Switch between Body and Spirit Stances, changing your basic abilities.

abilities.name: Somersault
abilities.desc: Wukong can jump an additional time.

abilities.name: Silksong
abilities.desc: Your whip sings through the air, a graceful extension of your will, striking with honed precision.

abilities.name: Backlash
abilities.desc: Master the art of deflection by redirecting enemy projectiles and dealing damage to nearby enemies that pushes them back.

abilities.name: Lash Kick
abilities.desc: With a flick, your whip becomes a tether, propelling you towards an enemy target or terrain.

abilities.name: Windburn
abilities.desc: Channel the wind's fury, extending your whip's reach and gaining the ability to cleave through multiple enemies with increased force.

abilities.name: Quelling Gale
abilities.desc: Summon a raging vortex that ensnares and halts enemy projectiles, slows them down and grants you increased movement speed.

abilities.name: Rising Storm
abilities.desc: Dealing damage builds up stacking attack speed. Go too long without dealing damage and this effect ends.

abilities.name: Kokoroken
abilities.desc: Slice through foes, Body and Spirit.

abilities.name: Whispering Echoes
abilities.desc: Hurl three exploding Kunai that mark targets for Severance.

abilities.name: Anima Burst
abilities.desc: Perform a spinning kick to unleash souls, damaging, marking nearby enemies and healing you if they are a hero or monster. Casting in-air will cause you to leap upwards.

abilities.name: Severance
abilities.desc: Rush forwards cutting through enemies in your path. If marked, their spirit is seperated, sharing damage dealt to it back to its host.

abilities.name: Soulstorm
abilities.desc: Unleash a storm of souls, damaging and slowing nearby enemies before pulling them towards you, tearing their spirits from their body. Then perform a final downwards slash to strike all nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Hallowed Strikes
abilities.desc: After casting an ability, empower your blade for your next two attacks to launch soul wave projectiles that deal bonus damage and bounce between foes.

abilities.name: Nyrian Spear
abilities.desc: Pierce through your enemies with the Nyrian Spear.

abilities.name: Spear of Nyr
abilities.desc: Channel to throw The Spear of Nyr, dealing damage. Tapping this ability instead instantly stabs with the spear and reduces its cooldown.

abilities.name: Barricade
abilities.desc: Unfold a shield reducing incoming damage for the duration. Upon recasting or after the duration, swing the shield dealing damage and stunning.

abilities.name: Evade
abilities.desc: Dash in your current movement direction, gaining movement speed and attack speed for a short duration.

abilities.name: Coliseum
abilities.desc: Leap at an enemy hero, dealing damage and spawning a coliseum around them. Killing this enemy in the coliseum permanently grants power.

abilities.name: Gladiator
abilities.desc: Gain a stack of Gladiator when dealing damage. Stacks grant increased power. After exiting combat, stacks will restore health.

abilities.name: Refibrillator
abilities.desc: Stop the hearts of your enemies with your repurposed medical device, The Refibrilator.

abilities.name: Infuse
abilities.desc: Fire a healing bolt at an ally that restores health.

abilities.name: Ricochet
abilities.desc: Throw an electromagnetic disk dealing damage and stunning. The disk can ricochet to multiple targets.

abilities.name: Bad Medicine
abilities.desc:
Shoot the ground to form a pool of radiation that deals damage and slows,

After a duration the radiation erupts, dealing damage and slowing.

abilities.name: Neural Regenesis
abilities.desc:
Apply cellular restructuring to yourself or an ally, granting movement speed and Revival for a duration.
If the target takes lethal damage within this time, they will Resurrect.

abilities.name: Triage Protocol
abilities.desc:
Gain a stack when damaging enemy heroes.

At maximum stacks gain movement speed.
